title: Two modules, one calculation: pass data and receive a result
goal: Locate a function and its caller, pass inputs explicitly, and explain an allowed external call without inventing permissions.

prerequisites.text: Complete BSL fundamentals: variables, types, conditions, and loops. Know how to preserve a separate source and run your training infobase.

sections.title: Why this task matters
paragraphs: A form, a document, and a report may need the same cost. Duplicating the formula makes it easy to fix just one copy. Put the calculation in one place and pass its minutes and rate explicitly.

Read the worked example and predict a changed input. The independent task uses a different contract. Save the previous training source before replacing a module; a personal Nexus mark is not an assessment of your explanation.

sections.title: Code location determines available data
paragraphs: The managed application module handles application events. Object modules belong to particular objects; form modules have form-specific data and context. A common module contains procedures and functions for other permitted callers. Identical procedure names in two modules do not create one shared implementation.

A cost formula may be needed by a form, a document and a report. Copying it into every place creates diverging implementations. A common module provides one calculation location but does not automatically receive the current form’s minutes. Pass minutes and the rate explicitly so identical inputs produce identical results.

sections.title: The complete worked example and its result
paragraphs: There are two separate sources: Стоимость belongs to the УчебныеРасчеты common module; ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы belongs to the application module. Do not paste both files into one editor. Match the call with its returned number 600.
Match code and result by each statement’s role. Explain matching output through inputs, execution order, and state; one observed run does not check every possible variant.

sections.title: Two settings answer different questions
paragraphs: Экспорт makes the method callable from another permitted module. The common module properties determine execution contexts. This exercise enables Server and Server call and disables Managed application client, Global and Privileged. Return values reuse is DontUse. These are settings for this particular calculation, not a universal module template.

Server call exposes the module through the platform’s client-to-server mechanism. It does not create an HTTP API or bypass user rights. A file infobase still distinguishes logical client and server contexts; this exercise does not prove a separately deployed network server or license a training client-server installation.

sections.title: Trace the important transitions
paragraphs: 600 does not appear because the common module read an open form. The calling handler supplied two numbers. A calculation without hidden form reads or document writes is easier to test independently of the interface.
Before the next statement, record state separately from messages already displayed. This finds the first divergence rather than guessing from the final line.

sections.title: Your prediction before revealing
paragraphs: Change only 30 minutes to 45, keeping the rate 1200. What should the caller receive?
Write your answer before revealing it. Identify the changed input and unchanged rule, then compare with the changed example.

reveal.title: Check the prediction
paragraphs: Match the changed values with the same rule. This checks transfer rather than memorisation of the previous final line.

sections.title: Pass only the necessary inputs
paragraphs: The first editor contains the exported function. The second contains a startup handler calling УчебныеРасчеты.Стоимость(30, 1200). Before the dot is the common module name; after it is the method name. The function validates types and ranges, returns a rounded number and writes no documents.

Do not replace parameters with an implicit “current request” global. That would make tests depend on earlier windows and execution order. If database access becomes necessary, isolate and name it explicitly and test it on an original synthetic dataset. Moving code into a common module alone does not make it pure or secure.

sections.title: A faulty variant and its first divergence
paragraphs: Remove Экспорт only in a separate training copy and repeat the external call. Validation or invocation must reject it. Record where rejection occurs, restore Экспорт, and repeat the positive call. Do not enable privileged mode to hide the error.
Keep the faulty variant separately. Restore the working version and repeat the positive case. Do not change an expectation merely because the program printed something else.

sections.title: Test an allowed and a prohibited call
paragraphs: First obtain 600 and preserve the working version. Only in a separate copy remove Экспорт, save, update and retry the external call. It must become unavailable. Do not enable every context or privileged mode to conceal the cause.

Restore Экспорт and repeat the positive run. Changing only 30 to 45 must give 900 while the function stays unchanged. Record whether rejection occurred during checking or execution. One rejected call is not proof of all permissions or all environments.

sections.title: See the values and direction
paragraphs: The diagram unfolds the selected sequence. Labels do not replace code: match each transition to a statement and record what remains unchanged.

The call arrow carries 30 and 1200 into Стоимость; the return carries only 600 back. Сообщить runs in the calling handler. Identify the boundary between modules: this is where method availability and explicit parameters matter.

sections.title: Now a different independent task
paragraphs: Create a different common-module function Остаток(Лимит, Занято): return unreserved minutes and reject wrong types, negative values, or reservations exceeding the limit. The application passes 120 and 45 and displays 75. Also test 0,120,121 reserved minutes; keep this task separate from Стоимость.
The worked example is not a ready solution to this task. Use a separate starter; reveal the reference on request after your own attempt. Viewing it must not replace saved or unsaved work.

sections.title: How to check transfer
paragraphs: The exported function is in the common module; the application contains one event handler and a qualified call.
Label each control input, expected observation, and reason in advance. Use rejection where the contract requires it; do not turn an unknown result into a convenient zero.

sections.title: The exact work location in 1C
paragraphs: There are two separate sources: Стоимость belongs to the УчебныеРасчеты common module; ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы belongs to the application module. Do not paste both files into one editor. Match the call with its returned number 600.

In your separate training infobase, save the source, update the database configuration, and launch a new session from Designer. Distinguish the editor, saved configuration, and running version; an old session does not prove the new text ran.

paragraphs: Reserved minutes 45/0/120 produce 75/120/0;121 is rejected rather than converted to 0.

The source and expected messages accompany the explanation. Actual images of the complete worked example come from a separate training infobase; they are not your run or proof of your authorship. Record your independent work separately.

sections.title: What is established and what still needs explanation
paragraphs: The file infobase checks this logical call path. It does not deploy a network server or prove arbitrary user permissions. Export and context flags explain method availability; they do not replace access design.

Before marking completion, explain one changed input of your own. A technical pass, matching messages, and your completion mark are different facts; understanding is discussed through explanation and transfer.
